hotels.title: Boutique Tasmania Vineyard Escape near Hobart with Daily Breakfast & Animal Feeding Experience
hotels.description: Made for those looking to get away from the bustling city while still having Hobart within reach, this stay offers a unique opportunity to reconnect with nature amid the stunning Tasmania countryside. Just a 30-minute drive from Hobart, this soothing retreat offers a seamless combination of countryside charm and contemporary comforts. Wander the serene farmland alongside the animals that roam the orchard and vineyard - including alpacas, sheep, geese, turkeys, ducks and chickens - and keep an eye out for Woody Island’s white-bellied sea eagles in the sky or brown tree frogs in the lily pond. When hunger strikes, savour seasonal dishes featuring local produce at Orani or devour succulent fruits from the orchards. As the sun sets, retire to your calming room or pavilion with cypress wood interiors and sweeping views.
